signature.name: VTask.DeleteFar
signature.type: {V : Type u_1} -> (G : SimpleGraph V) -> {𝕜 : Type u_2} -> [Ring 𝕜] -> [PartialOrder 𝕜] -> [Fintype ↑G.edgeSet] -> (p : SimpleGraph V → Prop) -> (r : 𝕜) -> Prop

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: DeleteFar is a universally quantified inequality Prop with no junk-value conventions; it is well-defined for all inputs in its natural domain, including r ≤ 0 where the condition becomes trivially satisfiable.

facts.statement: ∀ {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) {𝕜 : Type*} [Ring 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜] [Fintype ↑G.edgeSet] (p : SimpleGraph V → Prop) (r₁ r₂ : 𝕜), VTask.DeleteFar G p r₂ → r₁ ≤ r₂ → VTask.DeleteFar G p r₁

facts.statement: ∀ {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) {𝕜 : Type*} [Ring 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜] [Fintype ↑G.edgeSet] (p : SimpleGraph V → Prop) (r : 𝕜), VTask.DeleteFar G p r → p ⊥ → r ≤ (G.edgeFinset.card : 𝕜)
